args: D5a-01 opened (25 October): stage D5, the branch accounts, one leg per branch; this leg F01, the first. Read AGENT.md, the head, STAGE-D5, diary --last 5, validate --open D5 (case.md and forms/<id>.md read as literal names; per-room files exist), and stage_D5.py's check. Section 1, declared before any comparison (rule 6): the arrows compared are A01 to A21. Their within-case datings, the subs in model/arrows.jsonl, number 2 (A01 to A04, A07 to A11), 3 (A05, A06, A12, A20), 4 (A13 to A19) and 0 (A21); the minimum an arrow stands on is 2, and A21 stands on none. The expectation in a branch is the arrow's subs over the 705 analysed rooms times the branch's n. For the largest branch, F01 (103), it is 0.29 for 2 subs and 0.58 for 4; for the smallest, F14 (7), 0.02 to 0.04. So every arrow is not-testable-here in every branch: no arrow absence, no boundary condition and no propositions_fail may be written from the arrows in this stage, and every proposition (N01 to N09 rest only on arrows) is not testable. Members' accepted lines on an arrow are reported as description only.

Rule for section 2.8 (fourth-order themes over- and under-represented), written before it runs, the same for every branch: each room's coded concepts are counted by the fourth-order themes of their second-order theme's placements (a theme placed on several splits its concepts equally; concepts on residue or unplaced are left out), as the comparison composes rooms. The branch's pooled share of concepts on a theme is set against the pooled share over all 705 rooms. Over-represented: ratio 1.5 or more and the theme present in 5 or more members. Under-represented: ratio 0.67 or less, with the population share at 1 per cent or more. These are shares of what the coders coded in these rooms, never a property of the rooms (contract section 5). Script: out/_analysis/d5_themes.py.
compacted; head reconciled: head at the D4a-04 close; diary shows D5a-01 opened, section 1 declared, theme rule logged; next: finish d5_themes.py and run it for F01.

Section 2.8 for F01 by out/_analysis/d5_themes.py (output d5a01_F01_themes.json): over-represented T4-001 Keying only (branch share 0.406 against 0.183, ratio 2.22, all 103 members); under-represented T4-009, T4-010, T4-013, T4-015, T4-016, T4-018, T4-019, T4-020, T4-021, T4-023, T4-025 (ratios 0.07 to 0.67). Keying takes 41 per cent of the branch's coded concepts, so every other share falls; the under list is read with that in view.

Rule for section 2.10 (representative members), written before it runs, the same for every branch: fit is a member's share of its coded concepts on the fourth-order theme the branch key targets (a third-order target is read at its fourth-order parent). Best fit: the highest share among members with verdict composes and two or more lines on the key. Worst fit: the lowest share among members, ties broken by fewer key lines. Read at length: the member in the most of the branch's subforms, ties broken by more key lines, then by more coded concepts; a branch without subforms takes the member with the most key lines. Script: out/_analysis/d5_reps.py.

Representatives for F01 by the logged rule (d5_reps.py; d5a01_F01_reps.json): best fit MMA (composes, 3 key lines, 77 per cent of coded concepts on Keying); worst fit phish (composes with residue, 1 key line, 7 per cent on Keying); read at length dankmemes (in 3 of the 5 subforms, 4 key lines, 602 concepts). 164 key lines over 103 members.

F01 section 2.6 by d5_elements.py (d5a01_F01_elements.json): K01 instantiated and added to in all 103 members; P05 restricted in 62 of 103 (population 347 of 705); propose lines in 64 of 103 members (population 240 of 705), 138 lines; 22 of them in 18 rooms name ordinary sub activity beside the event. Idle in most members, as in the population: P34 (102 absent), P28 (93), P30 (92), P33 (92). Survival (d5_line_fields.py): median organizing end hour 71.98 (population 72.02 over 696 dated), mean aftermath share 0.0126 (population 0.02); work remained kept 51, lost 42, silent 10 of 103 (population 347, 218, 140 of 705). Canvas, projected afterwards: median area 610.5 px, 103 with artwork, 67th percentile, which follows room size. Nearest branch by Jaccard F09 (12 shared rooms, 0.083); 132 cross-links name F01 and 117 name its subforms.

F01 checks beside the logged rules: K01 is instantiated in 354 of 705 rooms (251 outside F01) and added to (add-step) in 115; F01's members have a median of 201 coded concepts against 101 over 705 (the size confound). Theme shares with Keying (T4-001) left out of both pools, a check beside the logged rule and not a replacement: under-represented only T4-020 (0.556), T4-021 (0.413), T4-023 (0.091); over T4-007 (1.68) and T4-012 (1.525). So most of the logged under list follows from Keying's 41 per cent share. 14 of 103 members hold two or more of the five steps (subforms); 66 have one line on the key. Nearest-branch room either way: stargate (2 lines on F01's key, 2 on F09's). Form test, decided before writing section 12: a grouping, not a form. The constructs can be named (K01 and its five steps under T4-001), but the members do not show the relations among the steps: at most 14 rooms hold two or more, and the branch binds no construct of canvas organizing.

forms/F01-account.md written (6,698 words; 4,936 of prose in five parts under out/_analysis/d5a01_F01_part*.md, the rest filled by d5_assemble.py from the files: all 103 unresolved members, the two held proposals as tree-D4.md states them, the 21 arrows' expectations, 132 cross-links naming F01 and 117 naming its subforms). prose_check: 0 hits. Names: 'administered' cannot be defended from all members (r/AMD, r/minecraft, r/phish did the step without anyone running the play); renaming proposal to notes-D5.md. Members showed what the room notes did not predict: 18 members carry propose lines on ordinary sub life going on beside the event.

D5a-01 closing. F01 accounted (forms/F01-account.md; branches-D5.jsonl line 1): a grouping, not a form; shared status unresolved; all 103 members' local accounts unresolved; verdicts on the original model composes 54, with residue 49; binds information, leaves division, allocation and reward free; over T4-001, under 11 themes (3 with Keying left out); all 21 arrows not-testable-here (expected 0 to 0.584); propositions N01 to N09 not testable; survival median end 71.98, kept 51, lost 42, silent 10. notes-D5.md begun; two defects lines (the renaming proposal, the model's gap for ordinary sub life).
